title: Shopping
summary: Product search, current prices and stock, specifications, reviews and bestseller rankings across major retailers, plus wholesale sourcing.
when: comparing products or prices across stores, current price or stock for an item, product reviews and ratings, bestsellers in a category, or wholesale suppliers for sourcing

providers.summary: Amazon US search, product details, buy-box price and stock for up to five ASINs, specifications, reviews and category bestsellers.
Walmart search, category browsing, item details and reviews.
Best Buy search, product details, pricing, store pickup and delivery availability by ZIP, and reviews.
Newegg search, live price and stock, and open-box listings for electronics and PC parts.
eBay listing details, per-variation prices and shipping for a known item number.
Etsy listing details, variations and similar listings from a known listing; keyword search is not available.
Wholesale product search, MOQ and quantity price tiers, specifications and supplier summaries.

skill: Reuse the supplied product, budget, must-have features, location or ZIP and preferred stores. Ask only for details that materially change the recommendation. Check the retailers relevant to the item and region; not every provider is needed.

Provider nextTool calls browse compact capabilities with prices. For a selected capability, call firecrawl_find_tools with providers: [provider ID], capabilities: [capability ID], expand: [options, response] and includeCosts: true. Use the live contract for inputs, coverage and credit costs; explain costs before paid execution through firecrawl_scrape with alexandria: {provider, capability, options}. Batch price checks where a contract allows several items per call.

Prices and stock change quickly: give the retailer, the time checked and whether the price is a displayed, list or open-box price; exclude shipping and tax unless the source includes them. Match the exact model and variant before comparing prices. Summarize reviews by theme with counts rather than cherry-picking. If a provider requires data terms, show them and ask an organization admin to accept them in the Firecrawl dashboard; a request for data is not acceptance.
Return a compact comparison table and a clear pick with the trade-offs. Do not place orders or add items to carts.

examples.request: What's the cheapest place to buy a Sony WH-1000XM5 right now?
examples.approach: Search Amazon, Best Buy and Walmart for the exact model, read current prices and stock, and show a table with retailer, price, condition and time checked.

examples.request: Find suppliers for custom printed tote bags at 500 units.
examples.approach: Alibaba retail/search, then price_tiers for the 500-unit price and supplier for tenure and country; present three suppliers with MOQ and unit price, noting shipping is excluded.
